name: Caring For Others
overview: Scripture calls believers to actively care for others by showing compassion and love, especially to the poor and needy, as doing so is regarded as lending to the Lord Himself and fulfilling Christ’s law. Ignoring the cries of the poor leads to personal judgment, while bearing one another's burdens exemplifies the love Christ commands. Christians are encouraged to persevere in good works, trusting that God will reward their faithful service in due time.
